sentences.en: Loads of people have phoned you
NINA: I felt just like your secretary!
sentences.zh: NINA: 我感觉自己简直就像你的秘书！

sentences.en: I went into the library this afternoon to have a look at a newspaper and came across something really interesting
sentences.zh: 我今天下午去了图书馆，想查份报纸，结果偶然发现了一件特别有趣的东西。

sentences.en: GEORGE: No, a brochure from a summer festival - mainly Spanish music
sentences.zh: GEORGE: 不是，是一份夏季音乐节的宣传册——主要是西班牙音乐。

sentences.en: Look, I've Example got it here
NINA: Spanish music? really love the guitar
sentences.zh: NINA: 西班牙音乐？我真的很喜欢吉他。

sentences.en: Let's have a look. a So what's this group 'Guitarrini'?
sentences.zh: 我们来看看。那么这个‘吉塔里尼’（Guitarrini）乐队是什么情况？

sentences.en: They had a video with all the highlights of the festival at a stand in the lobby to the library, so I heard them
sentences.zh: 他们在图书馆大厅的一个展台播放了这场音乐节所有精彩片段的视频，所以我听过他们的演奏。

sentences.en: They play fantastic instruments - drums and flutes and old kinds of guitars
sentences.zh: 他们演奏的乐器非常出色——有鼓、长笛，还有各种古老的吉他类型。

sentences.en: I've never heard anything like it before
sentences.zh: 我以前从未听过这样的音乐。

sentences.en: GEORGE: The only problem is there aren't any cheap seats it's all one price
sentences.zh: GEORGE: 唯一的问题是，没有便宜的座位——所有座位价格都一样。

sentences.en: NINA: Well, in that case we could sit right at the front - we'd have a really good a view
sentences.zh: NINA: 那这样的话，我们可以坐在最前排——视野会特别好。

sentences.en: GEORGE: Yeah, though I think that if you sit at the back you can actually hear the whole thing better
sentences.zh: GEORGE: 是啊，不过我觉得坐在后排反而能更完整地听到整场演出。

sentences.en: Anyway we can decide when we get there
sentences.zh: 反正等我们到了现场再决定吧。

sentences.en: NINA: So will you fill in the form or shall I?
sentences.zh: NINA: 那么，你来填这张表格，还是我来填？

sentences.en: Do you remember our new postcode?
sentences.zh: 你还记得我们的新邮政编码吗？

sentences.en: NINA: Just a minute - I've got it written down here
sentences.zh: NINA: 稍等一下——我这儿写下来了。

sentences.en: Do you need the phone too?
So, let's book two tickets for Guitarrini
sentences.zh: 那么，我们为Guitarrini订两张票吧。

sentences.en: If you're sure is £7.50 each is all right
sentences.zh: 如果你确定的话，每张7.50英镑，没问题。

sentences.en: How do you feel about the singer?
sentences.zh: 你对这位歌手感觉如何？

sentences.en: But I've noticed something on the booking form that might just persuade me!
sentences.zh: 但我注意到预订表上有一条信息，或许能说服我！

sentences.en: Singer, ticket £6.00 includes drinks in the garden
sentences.zh: 歌手演出，票价6.00英镑，包含花园饮品。

sentences.en: GEORGE: Sounds like a bargain to me!
sentences.zh: GEORGE: 听起来真是个划算的买卖！

sentences.en: NINA: Yes, let's book two tickets for that
sentences.zh: NINA: 是的，我们就订那场的两张票吧。

sentences.en: How about the pianist on the 22nd of June?
I've just remembered that's my evening class night
sentences.zh: 我刚想起来那天晚上是我上课的时间。

sentences.en: I'll just have to go on my own - but we can go to the Spanish dance and guitar concert together, can't we?
sentences.zh: 那我就自己去好了——不过我们可以一起去看西班牙舞蹈与吉他音乐会，对吧？

sentences.en: GEORGE: Yes - I'm sure Tom and Kieran would enjoy that too
sentences.zh: GEORGE: 对——我相信汤姆和基兰也会喜欢那场演出。

sentences.en: Good heavens - £10.50 a ticket! can see we're going to have to go without food for the rest of the week - we'll need to book four!
sentences.zh: 天哪——票价高达10.50英镑一张！看来我们这周余下的时间得省着点吃饭了——我们得订四张票！

sentences.en: NINA: Wish we were students - look!
sentences.zh: NINA: 真希望我们还是学生——快看！

sentences.en: Children, Students and Senior Citizens get a 50% discount on everything
sentences.zh: 儿童、学生及老年人享受所有项目五折优惠。
